start.title: The Missing Ledger
start.text: Mara, who keeps the Pine & Mug, has misplaced the thin ledger she uses for debts too small to deserve the real book. She is certain it was on the common-room shelf before breakfast.

choices.text: Search without turning the inn upside down

buckets.flavourText: A clean rectangle in the dust shows where the ledger sat. Below it, a chair leg has fresh scrape marks leading toward the stove.
The common room contains a hundred plausible hiding places and twice as many distractions.

choices.text: Ask who was in the room this morning
Tell Mara it will turn up

stove.title: Behind the Wood Box
stove.text: The ledger is wedged behind the wood box beside the stove. It could have fallen there—except a strip of cloth has been tucked over it to hide the cover.

choices.text: Give it to Mara and mention the cloth
Glance at the last page before returning it

ask.title: Morning Company
ask.text: Mara lists a cooper, two caravan hands, a washerwoman, and her own nephew. The nephew becomes offended before anyone accuses him.

choices.text: Watch the reactions rather than the answers

buckets.flavourText: The washerwoman looks toward the stove every time the ledger is mentioned.
Everyone has a reason to look guilty when debts are involved.

peek.title: Small Debts
peek.text: The last page is mostly ale, lamp oil, and borrowed blankets. One entry is different: no name, only "north room — seven nights — paid in advance." The handwriting is Mara's.

choices.text: Ask Mara about the north room

return.title: Something Deliberate
return.text: Mara studies the cloth, says nothing, and puts the ledger under the bar instead of back on the shelf. "Thank you," she says, in a tone that closes the subject.

quiet_return.title: A Secret Not Asked For
quiet_return.text: You hand the book back closed. Mara checks the last page before thanking you, which tells you she knew exactly what was written there.

north_room.title: A Door Kept Shut
north_room.text: Mara's expression hardens. "If you want a room, I have six others." She takes the ledger and changes the subject.

leave.title: Other People's Accounts
leave.text: You leave Mara to search her own common room. Small debts have a way of resurfacing even when ledgers do not.
